design_overview: A modern, elegant flower delivery app designed with a clean, botanical aesthetic. The interface prioritizes visual product discovery through high-quality flower imagery, intuitive navigation, and streamlined checkout. The design uses soft, natural colors with rose pink as the primary accent, creating an inviting and premium feel. Each screen is optimized for touch interaction with clear visual hierarchy, making browsing, cart management, and order tracking effortless for customers.

responsive_design: Mobile-first design optimized for iOS and Android devices with screen sizes from 375px to 428px width. All touch targets minimum 44x44px for accessibility. Cards and lists use flexible layouts that adapt to screen width. Images use responsive sizing with aspect ratio preservation. Bottom navigation fixed for easy thumb access. Horizontal scrolling lists for categories and recommendations. Tablet layouts (768px+) show multi-column grids for product cards and utilize additional screen space for side-by-side content in checkout and detail views.
accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant with minimum contrast ratio 4.5:1 for text. All interactive elements have clear focus states with primary color outline. Touch targets minimum 44x44px. Screen reader support with semantic HTML and ARIA labels. Alternative text for all images. Form inputs have associated labels. Error messages clearly indicate issues and solutions. Color is not the only indicator of state (icons and text accompany color). Keyboard navigation support for web version. Dynamic text sizing support respects user system preferences.
animations: Subtle, purposeful animations enhance usability without distraction. Screen transitions use 300ms slide animations (right for forward, left for back). Button presses show 100ms scale down to 0.95. Cards have 200ms elevation change on press. Bottom sheets slide up with 250ms ease-out curve. Loading states use gentle pulsing skeleton screens. Success actions show brief checkmark animation. Cart badge animates with bounce when items added. Pull-to-refresh uses native platform patterns. All animations respect reduced motion preferences.
icons: Consistent icon set using outlined style for inactive states, filled for active states. Icons sourced from system defaults (SF Symbols for iOS, Material Icons for Android) ensuring native feel. Primary icons: home (house outline), search (magnifying glass), user (person outline), settings (gear), bell (notification), bookmark (ribbon), heart (favorite), filter (funnel), plus (add), edit (pencil), trash (bin), share (arrow up from box). Icons sized 24px for navigation, 20px for inline actions, 16px for supporting elements. All icons have 2px stroke weight for visual consistency.
